title: NgDoc Vite application
description: Builds an Angular application with Vite and the NgDoc Vite engine: the browser bundle, the server bundle and every prerendered route.

configFile.description: The Vite configuration file, relative to the workspace root.

outputPath.description: The output directory, relative to the workspace root: browser/, server/server.mjs and prerendered-routes.json.

ssr.description: Build the server bundle. Defaults to true when the Vite configuration's createNgDocApplicationPlugin has a server entry.

prerender.description: Prerender every route into browser/. Defaults to true when the server bundle is built.

routes.description: Routes prerendered in addition to the discovered ones, for example pages with route parameters.

routeTimeout.description: Fails a route that takes longer to render, in milliseconds. No limit by default.

discoverRoutes.description: Prerender every concrete route of the application's router configuration.
